dle_wi_import_report_em_explainer:
SillyTavern's "Example Messages" slot is a special prompt position for sample dialogue lines that ride alongside the example messages already in your chat. DeepLore doesn't have that slot — by default we tuck these entries' content under a "## Example Dialogue" subheader inside the entry body, so they still reach the model when the entry triggers.

Honestly, one short flavor quote inside a character entry is usually enough to teach an LLM the voice. If you'd rather skip them on future imports, the button below flips the setting permanently (until you change it back in Settings → DeepLore → Matching → Import → WI Example Messages on import). Entries already imported stay in the vault — /dle-delete them by name if you want them gone.

dle_lib_intro_7: Lay it on me. I have opinions about your taxonomy and three hours until close.

Each search call adds a round-trip to the generation (the model pauses, searches, then continues). Flag calls are cheaper (no round-trip results). Start with just the flag tool if you want to minimize cost and see what your AI reaches for before enabling search.
